def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    if not car_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Sort cars by their horizontal center
    car_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Filter out cars that are not aligned vertically within a tolerance
    vertical_tolerance = 50  # pixels
    aligned_cars = []
    for i in range(len(car_patches)):
        if i == 0 or abs(car_patches[i].vertical_center - car_patches[i-1].vertical_center) < vertical_tolerance:
            aligned_cars.append(car_patches[i])
    
    # Find the rightmost aligned car
    rightmost_car = max(aligned_cars, key=lambda p: p.right)
    
    # Find the parking area
    parking_area_patches = image_patch.find("parking area")
    if not parking_area_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Check if the rightmost car is on the right side of the parking area
    rightmost_car_center = (rightmost_car.left + rightmost_car.right) / 2
    parking_area_right = max(parking_area_patches, key=lambda p: p.right).right
    if rightmost_car_center > parking_area_right:
        return rightmost_car
    
    return image_patch
